purpose: Invalid slots are recorded separately from the archived jobs, so that an infrastructure or quota failure is never silently read as a 0 capability score and never enters the discrimination statistics.
immutability_note: The archived jobs tree is not rewritten. Every result.json, reward and log stays byte-for-byte as produced by the run; this file is an annotation layer on top of them.

invalid_criteria: The trial's agent_result status is not 'completed' (for example 'error'), or
The final/error text is a provider-side transport or quota failure (HTTP 429, AccountQuotaExceeded, HTTP 5xx, timeout), or
The verifier never ran on a candidate revision (no verifier_result / no checks.json produced by a real run).
replacement_policy: An invalid slot is bound to the same planned slot: same model alias, one trial per planned slot, same planned ordering, so a replacement never adds extra weight to a model.
A replacement is attempted only for transport/quota/timeout failures; an environment defect of our own is fixed first and then the whole slot re-runs.
A replacement is a fresh trial from the untouched workspace, never a re-prompt of a failed answer.
Every replacement keeps its own started_at / finished_at and runner identity.
counting_policy: Invalid slots are excluded from model_score_sum, testcase_pass_sum and every discrimination claim.
They are reported separately as infrastructure evidence.
A task must never pass or fail on the strength of an invalid slot.

runner_identity.note: Execution-time runner revision as recorded by the harness in each trial's agent/model-result.json; the archived value is the same file that ran.

current_archive_note: All 14 archived rounds ran to a terminal verdict: run_validity=VALID, reward in {0,1}, no provider or transport error. `slots` is therefore empty.
